serial.pesan: Merapikan yang mengganggu itu cabang iman

youtube.title: Sandal di Teras Masjid | Kakek Hasan dan Dimas #1
youtube.description:
Dimas melempar sandalnya begitu saja di teras masjid. Kakek Hasan tidak marah. Kakek merapikannya, satu per satu.

Iman itu lebih dari tujuh puluh cabang, yang paling rendah menyingkirkan gangguan dari jalan. (HR. Muslim 35)

#KakekHasanDanDimas #KisahIslami #JOTA #shorts

sources: HR. Muslim 35, dari Abu Hurairah: al-iman bidh'un wa sab'una syu'bah ... wa adnaha imathatul adza 'anith thariq. Sahih. Dicek 2026-11-06 di surahquran.com/Hadith-35106.html dan dorar.net

kamera.posisi: on the mosque terrace at chest height, medium-wide shot

klip.awal: Dimas stands at the edge of the white tiled terrace facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, wearing blue rubber sandals.

aksi.aksi: Dimas steps out of his blue sandals one after the other; they land apart on the tiles.
Only after both sandals are off, he turns his head toward the mosque door on the left.

klip.akhir: Two blue sandals lie apart on the tiles.
klip.latar: a village mosque terrace, birds and a light breeze

foley.suara: two rubber sandals dropping on a tiled floor

kamera.posisi: on the mosque terrace at chest height, medium shot

klip.awal: Kakek Hasan stands upright at the edge of the terrace facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, his brown leather sandals on his feet.

aksi.aksi: Kakek Hasan steps out of his brown sandals slowly and places them side by side.
Then he bends his knees and picks up the two blue sandals with both hands.

klip.akhir: Kakek Hasan holds the two blue sandals at waist height.

kamera.posisi: beside the shoe rack at chest height, medium shot
kamera.gerak: the camera follows Kakek Hasan slowly to the wooden shoe rack

klip.awal: Kakek Hasan holds the two blue sandals at waist height.

aksi.aksi: Kakek Hasan walks forward to the low wooden shoe rack on the right.
Then he places the blue sandals neatly side by side on the rack with both hands.

klip.akhir: The blue sandals sit neatly on the shoe rack beside other sandals.

foley.suara: sandals placed on a wooden shelf

kamera.posisi: at the mosque doorway at chest height, medium shot

klip.awal: Dimas stands in the open wooden mosque doorway facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, his hands at his sides.

aksi.aksi: Dimas raises his right hand and points toward the shoe rack on the right.

ucapan.text: Lho, Kek? Itu kan sandal Dimas.

klip.akhir: Dimas stands in the doorway with his right hand pointing to the right.

kamera.posisi: beside the shoe rack at chest height, medium shot

klip.awal: Kakek Hasan stands upright beside the low wooden shoe rack facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, his right hand resting on top of the rack.

aksi.aksi: Kakek Hasan pats the top of the shoe rack twice with his right hand.

ucapan.text: Merapikan sandal itu kecil, Dimas. Tapi Allah suka.

klip.akhir: Kakek Hasan stands beside the rack, his hand on top of it.

foley.suara: a hand patting a wooden shelf twice

kamera.posisi: beside the shoe rack at chest height, medium shot

klip.awal: Dimas stands upright beside the low wooden shoe rack facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, one pair of grey sandals lying apart on the tiles in front of him.

aksi.aksi: Dimas bends his knees, picks up the grey sandals with both hands, and places them neatly on the rack.

ucapan.text: Sandal bapak itu juga, ya, Kek!

klip.akhir: Dimas stands upright beside the neat rack.
